item.title: View Alert List
item.description: This section describes how to view the alert list. Prerequisites The WizTelemetry Alerting extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a cluster or project and have the Alert Viewing permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Alert Viewing permissions and enter your cluster or workspace.
